messages:
sara: FYI — AcmePay reported EU user requests showing as served from us-east-1 in our audit emails. They pasted a sample req id 000abc123. They say they got automated compliance alerts. @igor can you pull routing traces?
igor: Oncall — looking now. I see a p95 spike for eu-west and a lot of requests routed to us-east as a fallback. Traces: https://internal.trace/000abc123 (redacted). Also seeing a small number of 503s right before the fallback window.
maria: Heads up — last night's routing release changed fallback logic. deploy-bot shows route-policy-service v2.4.0 promoted ~03:12 UTC with new behavior: allow cross-region fallback for bursts when eu capacity < 5%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed for route-policy-service v2.4.0 - change: cross-region fallback enabled under low-capacity condition.
sara: That sounds like the cause. Customer requires EU residency; this is a potential breach. @daniel tagging Privacy.
daniel: We need scope & evidence. Ask for full list of request ids and timeframe. Preserve logs for audit (don't truncate). I'll start a compliance incident record.
jane-cust: Provided two examples from our side: req=000abc123 @ 2026-03-15T03:20:11Z, req=000abc789 @ 2026-03-15T03:22:05Z. We saw alerts from our DLP and got egress billing spikes.
igor: Pulled our traces for those ids. Both show header X-Region-Selected: us-east-1 and route decision fallback_region=us-east-1. Quick mitigation options: rollback route-policy to v2.3.7 or pin AcmePay tenant to eu-only routing.
maria: I can trigger rollback now. Also preparing a targeted gate to disable cross-region fallback for tenants with residency policies. Patch will be small.
sara: Customer wants confirmation and an ETA for root cause analysis. They also asked about credits for unexpected egress. Finance team has been pinged.
daniel: Required steps from Privacy: 1) snapshot routing decisions table for 2026-03-15T03:00:00Z -> 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z 2) export audit logs and traces for each affected req id 3) enumerate affected tenants 4) timeline & remediation plan. I'll need the raw logs.
igor: Initiating rollback: `kubectl -n routing set image deployment/route-policy route-policy=route-policy:v2.3.7` — executing now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started by maria at 2026-03-15T03:58:12Z. Health checks running.
maria: Rollback finished, policy reverted. Also pushed hotfix: gate cross-region fallbacks by tenant residency flag (PR https://git.internal/pr/485). I'll monitor traces.
sara: Told AcmePay we reverted the change and are compiling a compliance report within 24h. They requested audit exports and a short incident timeline to share with their DPO.
daniel: I'll draft the compliance report and notify DPO + log in compliance tracker. Also recommend offering one invoice credit for egress while we confirm final scope.
igor: Added temporary alert: any routing decision where tenant.residency==EU and routed_region!=eu-* will fire pager. Also added a dashboard tile for cross-region decisions.
sara: Great. Follow-ups: postmortem doc, customer remediation steps, and update release checklist so 'residency gates' are included in canaries.
jane-cust: Thank you — please CC our legal: legal@acmepay.com and send the audit export when ready.

Example audit snippet (from our exported trace):
`[2026-03-15T03:20:11Z] req=000abc123 tenant=acmepay src_region=eu-west-1 routed_region=us-east-1 route_policy=route-policy:v2.4.0 reason=fallback_capacity`

sara: Adding action items in the incident doc. I'll post links and the export when available. :thumbsup:
